data.Q: Who asks the Levite where he comes from?
Who installs the Levite as priest?
data.A: Micah installs the Levite as priest.
data.wrong_answer: The Levite installs Micah as priest.

data.Q: After the Levite agrees to live with Micah, what does Micah do?
data.A: Micah installs the Levite as priest.
data.wrong_answer: Micah offers him pay, clothes, and food.

data.Q: Why does Micah say the Lord will be good to him?
data.A: Because the Levite has become Micah’s priest.
data.wrong_answer: Because he gives the Levite silver each year.

data.Q: In whose house does the young man live?
data.A: The young man lives in Micah’s house.
data.wrong_answer: The young man lives in the young man’s house.

data.Q: After installation, what does the young man become for Micah?
data.A: The young man becomes Micah’s priest.
data.wrong_answer: The young man becomes Micah’s father.

data.Q: Who says he now expects the Lord’s favor?
data.A: Micah says he now expects the Lord’s favor.
data.wrong_answer: The Levite says he now expects the Lord’s favor.
